attacks.claim: `_upload` builds a shell command with `shell=True` by interpolating `local` and `dest`, both derived from `src.stem`. Partners choose their own SFTP filenames, so a crafted name containing shell metacharacters (e.g. `$(...)`, `;`, backticks) would execute arbitrary commands on workers that hold write credentials for the whole raw bucket.
attacks.evidence: f"gsutil -q -o GSUtil:parallel_composite_upload_threshold=150M cp {local} {dest}", shell=True, check=True  ...  path = out_dir / f"{src.stem}-{len(chunks):04d}.csv.gz"
